messages.subject: Scotland shapefile?
parts:
Hi 

Can anyone help me get shape files for Scotland? I tried to get the United Kingdom shapefiles from GitHub (downloaded them) and tried extracting the Scotland portion to model Foxes' habitat range. I got the following error:

> UK_Shape <- readOGR(dsn = "United Kingdom", layer = "gadm34_GBR_1")
Error in ogrInfo(dsn = dsn, layer = layer, encoding = encoding, use_iconv = use_iconv,  :
  Cannot open data source
> Scot_Shape <- UK_Shape[UK_Shape$NAME_1 == "Scotland",]    
Error: object 'UK_Shape' not found
>

Alok
